column1: # Weft English core lexicon — the source side of every pack.
# lemma | pos | zipf | band | senses | plural | gerund
# zipf   1..7, Zipf frequency (log10 occurrences per billion words). 7 is "the".
# band   1..6, roughly CEFR A1..C2. Drives which words a given level meets.
# senses count of distinct common English senses. Polysemy is penalised at
#        selection time: an out-of-context swap teaches the wrong sense, so
#        "light" (8 senses) is a far worse candidate than "bridge" (2).
# plural only when irregular; blank lets the builder apply English rules.
# Keyed on lemma AND part of speech: "work" the noun and "work" the verb are
# Weighted towards concrete nouns and adjectives. Those are the words a reader
# can recover from context, which is the whole mechanism: comprehensible input
# needs the surrounding sentence to do the teaching.
# ---- abstract, but concrete enough to guess --------------------------------
